facts.fact: The public social security fund CNSS officially launched on 5 December 2023 payment of retirement pensions by bank transfer or mobile money (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money), with an awareness campaign for pensioners running to 14 December 2023.
facts.system: CNSS pension payment by bank transfer or mobile money

systems.owner: Caisse Nationale de la Sécurité Sociale (CNSS)
